root_cause: Implicit sign extension from 16-bit product to 32-bit product_ext caused Verilator to emit a WIDTH warning, as ASSIGNW expects the RHS to explicitly match the 32-bit width of the LHS.
repair_summary: Added explicit sign extension using concatenation and replication to manually sign-extend the 16-bit product up to ACC_W (32 bits), satisfying Verilator's strict width matching requirements while maintaining signed correctness.
golden_principles_used: Preserve signed INT8 multiplication and INT32 accumulation
The multiplication result must be EXPLICITLY and correctly sign-extended to ACC_W before accumulation
verification_required: Functional verification must still be performed
